trust_decision.summary: Whether a user without release-write permission may download an attachment of a draft release; decided in the web ServeAttachment handler, which before the fix only checked CanRead(unit.TypeReleases), while the API side gates drafts with canAccessReleaseDraft.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'web attachment download missing authorization'; ServeAttachment is the single web handler that serves attachments by UUID, and the fix lands here.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /attachments/{uuid} (routers/web/web.go:886), GET /{u}/{r}/attachments/{uuid} (routers/web/web.go:1505), GET /{u}/{r}/releases/attachments/{uuid} (routers/web/web.go:1489), GET /{u}/{r}/{issues|pulls}/{index}/attachments/{uuid} (routers/web/web.go:1300); all via GetAttachment -> ServeAttachment

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All four UUID routes reach the same function ServeAttachment (routers/web/repo/attachment.go:228-229), so a fix at the landing point covers every one of them. The published fix has no site in another module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No real route left to dismiss. The only nearby candidate, /releases/download/{vTag}/{fileName}, already filters drafts (routers/web/repo/repo.go:308), and its 'latest' fallback excludes drafts (models/repo/release.go:332).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Release writers (owner, admin, collaborators with write) must still download draft attachments, readers must still download published-release attachments, and issue/PR attachments and unlinked attachments (uploader only) must stay unaffected. An over-broad fix that blocks every draft attachment, or that requires write access for all release attachments, breaks these cases.

O6_input_shapes: release attachment reached through the repo-scoped UUID route (ctx.Repo set, perm = ctx.Repo.Permission)
release attachment reached through the global /attachments/{uuid} route (ctx.Repo nil, perm computed through GetDoerRepoPermission)
release attachment UUID reached through the issue/PR attachments route
anonymous vs signed-in non-collaborator vs writer/admin

O7_producer.where: services/repository/repository.go:186-207 (GetAttachmentLinkedTypeAndRepoID loads the release but returns only unit type and repo ID, discarding IsDraft)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The 'latest' alias fallback in RedirectDownload could resolve the release through a helper that does not filter is_draft (for example a FindReleasesOptions lookup without IncludeDrafts gating).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fallback was added separately to support GitHub-compatible 'latest' links. A maintainer could plausibly reuse a generic latest-release lookup there and forget drafts, because the main branch of the function already gates drafts at line 308.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The mail base64 image embedder opens any same-repo attachment by UUID, checking only RepoID; a copy could embed draft release attachments into notification mail to readers.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a second, non-HTTP path from UUID to attachment bytes that sits in another package (services/mailer). It checks only repo ownership, so a missing draft/permission check is a believable omission. This is a separate concept from the web handler, so a solver could argue it out of scope as a 'mail feature'.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: TagsList deliberately uses IncludeDrafts: true for all readers; a variant template that renders release attachment links on the tags page would expose draft attachment UUIDs.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comment at routers/web/repo/release.go:222-223 gives a legitimate reason to include drafts there, which is a ready-made 'reason to dismiss'.

O9_family: missing authorization / broken access control (CWE-862/CWE-639): draft release attachment readable by read-only users through UUID download URLs

O10_build.language: Go (plus a JS frontend that integration tests do not need)
O10_build.toolchain: Go toolchain per go.mod, make; integration tests use SQLite by default
O10_build.project_tests: tests/integration/attachment_test.go testGetAttachment (table-driven UUID cases; fixture attachment id 13, uuid ...a23, at models/fixtures/attachment.yml:158-159); tests/integration/api_releases_attachment_test.go:42 testAPIDraftReleaseAttachmentAccess covers the API side

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the draft check only to the /releases/attachments/{uuid} route handler (or only when ctx.Repo is set), which leaves the global /attachments/{uuid} route and the issue-scoped UUID route serving draft attachments.

out_of_scope_notes: TagsList shows draft releases to all readers by design (routers/web/repo/release.go:222-224); this is draft metadata, not attachment bytes; not pursued.
Both fix commits carry the identical patch (backport, fix.diff:1-47 vs fix.diff:49-95).
